title: Silver Spring, MD — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Silver Spring is a city in MD with a population of 81,000. DC suburb with the AFI Silver Theatre, a vibrant downtown, and Discovery Communications. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
